notes: The margin Or, passing over was read and set aside (rule 38).
The on of coming on stays with the participle: the direction it states is written in the clause by עָלָיו, so it restates what the Hebrew writes rather than supplying what it does not (rule 44).
אַפָּיו takes the supplied with as an adverbial accusative, discontinuous around the possessive (rules 25, 33).
